title: Concurrent first requests for one session can start two Engram control processes, and the loser is killed after it may have rotated the resume token
outcome: ProcessEngramControlTransport::process_for (src/engram_control_transport.rs:100-149 at d1d92bbb) spawns the control process OUTSIDE the registry lock (:124-129) and then picks a winner (:130-147). Two concurrent first requests for one session can each start a real Engram control connection, and each may rotate the resume_control_connection token (Engram control_runtime.rs:586-625) before the loser is terminated, so the loser can supersede the winner. Startup is serialised per session: at most one control process starts per session at a time, and others wait for it. A deterministic test drives two concurrent first requests and checks the real nonce or resume rotation on a disposable store.
acceptance: Concurrent first requests for one session can start two Engram control processes, and the loser is killed after it may have rotated the resume token is done
